title: Research: Heisenberg central-pair call floor (no new kappa)
body:
## Result

This package gives an exact call-minimum result for one new nonabelian register model. In the formal algebra `F2[UT3(F3)]`, with two scalar registers and paid shears over the four generator labels `x, x^-1, y, y^-1`, the endpoint `diag([z],[z])` for `z=[x,y]` needs exactly eight calls.

Applying the commutator word `x y x^-1 y^-1` once to each register gives the eight-call upper bound. A complete meet-in-the-middle search over all six binary rank-one idempotents and all four labels excludes every word of lengths 0 through 7. The exact sorted-state receipts cover 82,063 distinct length-four products; `EXPECTED.json` records hashes and every tested split. Free scalar `GL2(F2)` changes are absorbed because all rank-one idempotents are enumerated and the target is scalar.

## Verification

```text
python3 -B research/heisenberg-central-pair-seed0154/verify.py
PASS_HEISENBERG_CENTRAL_PAIR minimum=8 excluded_lengths=0..7 group_order=27 characteristic=2 registers=2 generators=4 idempotents=6 controls=6 matrix_crosschecks=144 state_counts=[(0, 1), (1, 24), (2, 413), (3, 5927), (4, 82063)]

python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/heisenberg-central-pair-seed0154 --check-only
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
```

The exact replay also passes under `python3 -I -O -B`.

## Scope and attribution

This is limited to the named finite group, two registers, four-label alphabet and endpoint. It rejects a commutator-sharing saving in this model; it does not bound other nonabelian groups or establish physical supplier adoption. No new kappa or integer-multiplication claim is made.

PR #1822 studies the related Q8 central pair. This changes the group to odd order 27 over coefficient field F2, and the central target has order three with a four-letter direct generator word. The full overlap refresh is recorded in `README.md`; the handoff is on [Discussion #1167](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18926907).

Assignment base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; current PR base is the latest `main`. The selected record hash remains `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`. Exact assignment and predecessor source pins are retained in `TASK.json` and `SOURCES.json`.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No predecessor code is copied. New work is Apache-2.0.
